title: scorpiurus subvillosus subvar. eriocarpus
intro: Scorpiurus subvillosus subvar. eriocarpus, commonly known as the spiny restharrow, is a flowering plant in the legume family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various ailments, with reported health benefits including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Scorpiurus subvillosus subvar. eriocarpus include its ability to relieve pain, reduce fever, and treat respiratory issues such as coughs and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
